title: Preserve quantitative and epistemic boundaries
prompt:
请把下面一段改得更简洁、更准确，保持英文，不要增加事实：

Under crash-stop failures, \sys{} recovered 97.3\% of interrupted requests in our 128-node experiment (Fig.~\ref{fig:recovery}) \cite{lee2026}. We plan to evaluate Byzantine faults in future work.

established: 97.3 percent of interrupted requests recovered in one 128-node experiment under crash-stop failures

forbidden_actions: turn future work into completed work
hard_gates: The Byzantine evaluation remains explicitly planned rather than completed.
The result remains bounded to crash-stop failures and the 128-node experiment.
expected_behavior: Preserve the measured value, denominator object, scale, failure model, figure, and citation.
Keep future work epistemically separate from observed results.
Do not narrate an editing workflow.

rubric.criterion: Returns revised English prose before commentary.
Preserves \cite{lee2026} exactly and in a valid support position.
Keeps Byzantine evaluation as future work.
Does not add a cause for recovery success.
Does not broaden the result to all requests, systems, or scales.
Improves economy without dropping a scientific condition.
Limits any post-prose note to a material blocker or consequential validation.
